representation_fit.evidence: Brief demands monitor×volatile-evidence-stream (many/high temporality/high density/high volatility, object=metric). Both viewports show a dense metric-tile grid (28 metrics, 4 domains) with live values, /1min deltas, threshold-banded sparklines and status dots (1280x860.png; 1440x900.png); source defines warn/crit bands per metric (source/app.js:35-63) and a scripted anomaly/incident engine driving volatility (source/app.js:66-74). Representation matches the cell's shape bundle directly.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Monitoring dominates the initial screen: header status counts 29 正常/2 警告/1 严重, an attention bar directly under the topbar lists the 3 live anomalies with value+duration (1280x860.png top row: 结账错误率 5.16% 严重·01:22, 支付队列积压 427 警告·00:44, 索引同步延迟 16.4s 警告·00:20), the anomalous tiles are color-flagged in-grid (red 结账错误率 5.16% 严重 持续 01:22), and the right rail streams state transitions. Anomalies are glanceable without scrolling; grid occupies the majority of both viewports.

time_to_understand.evidence: Title 'PULSEWATCH 指标流监视台' plus per-tile status words (正常/警告/严重), a footer legend mapping the three colors, and header counts make the what/where readable at first glance (1280x860.png; source/index.html:13,63-68; source/styles.css:192-199). Model-judged proxy only, per rubric.

navigation_cost.evidence: Zero-step reachability of the primary object: alert-bar chips are buttons that select+scroll+ping the metric (source/app.js:329-334,379-384); every grid tile is a button with click→select (source/app.js:166-186); feed rows are clickable (source/app.js:359-363); category chips, 仅看异常 filter (index.html:26-29) and a ?select= deep link (source/app.js:498-500) give one-screen access with no modes or routing.

context_loss.evidence: Selection renders the trace into the persistent right rail while grid, alert bar and event feed stay visible (source/index.html:35-61; source/app.js:369-377 select() toggles panels, no navigation); filtering only hides tiles (source/app.js:418-426) and the deep-link select keeps everything else intact — primary actions preserve context structurally.

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Surfaces are mostly need-driven for a 28-metric volatile stream (topbar counts, alert bar, grouped grid, feed+detail rail, footer legend). Deduction: the topbar carries 8 permanent controls (5 filter chips + 仅看异常 + 速度 + 暂停, index.html:25-30) and at 1440x900 they overflow — 暂停 wraps to a second row (1440x900.png top-right) — indicating the permanent header surface exceeds its container; the detail panel also occupies rail space as an empty-state placeholder until selection (index.html:44).

accessibility.evidence: measurement-summary.json: a11y.contrast=fail and a11y.focus_order=fail (a11y.target_size=pass is the only pass). Source shows partial intent — aria-label per tile (app.js:169), aria-pressed on 仅看异常 (app.js:484), aria-hidden decorative canvas (app.js:174), role=group chips (index.html:26), prefers-reduced-motion (styles.css:207-210) — but styles.css defines no :focus/:focus-visible styling, and a faint text tier (#5a6675 on #0d131a, styles.css:5, used at 11px for hints/timestamps) is consistent with the contrast failure.

frontend_rework.evidence: Defect part only: measurement-summary.json reports layout.overflow=fail and type.min_projected_size=fail, corroborated visually — in 1440x900.png the topbar control row overflows and 暂停 wraps to a second line; canvas threshold labels are drawn at 9px (source/app.js:233-235) and meta text at 10-11px (styles.css:63,76,173,180). No broken/overlapping panels or truncated text are visible in either screenshot (text.truncation=pass, layout.responsive_collision=pass), so rework needed is localized to the topbar sizing and small type, not structural.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '指标变化可追溯，无闪烁噪声' is addressed on both halves. Traceable: global event stream with transition+value per event (app.js:346-363), per-metric 状态变化史 list (app.js:404-414), event tick-marks on the detail curve (app.js:241-252), 持续 mm:ss durations (app.js:298), and 240 pre-seeded history samples so anomalies already carry traceable history at first paint (app.js:137-145; visible as 01:12:14 索引同步延迟 正常→警告·转为警告 15.8s in 1280x860.png). No-flicker: hysteresis state machine (2-sample trigger / 3-sample recover, app.js:111-124), fixed grid ordering ('网格定序不重排', index.html:67), in-place textContent/canvas-only updates (app.js:275-301), tabular-nums (styles.css:19), one-shot non-looping ping animation (styles.css:136-146).

defects_observed: Topbar control row overflows at 1440x900: 暂停 button wraps to a second row (1440x900.png top-right), matching measurement check layout.overflow=fail
Small-type failures: 9px canvas threshold labels (app.js:233-235) and 10-11px hint/meta text (styles.css:63,76) consistent with type.min_projected_size=fail
Accessibility receipt failures a11y.contrast=fail and a11y.focus_order=fail; no :focus styling defined in styles.css and faint #5a6675 text tier on dark panels

At 1280x860 only 2 of 4 metric groups are fully above the fold (检索 SEARCH group header just visible at bottom edge) — inherent to the 28-tile density, mitigated by the alert bar and filters but still off-screen content on the initial viewport
scores.overall_note: The package is a faithful representation for the monitor×volatile-evidence-stream cell: a single-screen, dense metric grid with threshold-banded sparklines, an attention bar surfacing the three live anomalies at first glance, a global event stream, and a per-metric trace panel with change history and curve markers — directly covering the acceptance seed's traceability and no-flicker requirements, which are also implemented structurally (hysteresis thresholds app.js:111-124, fixed grid order, in-place updates, seeded 240-sample history so the page is usable at load). Navigation is one click from alert bar, tile, or feed with no mode changes or context loss. The measurable weaknesses are concentrated in polish: 4 of 7 receipt checks fail (layout.overflow, a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, type.min_projected_size), corroborated by the 1440x900 topbar overflow where 暂停 wraps, the absence of focus styling, sub-10px canvas labels, and a low-contrast faint text tier. Error-rate evidence (measurement-summary.json) is referenced as supplied and not rescored; task time, retrieval accuracy, and human preference are not observable in this blind pilot, and model-judged legibility here is a proxy, not human preference.
